# Reefing the mainsail

Reefing shrinks the mainsail when the wind builds, so the boat stays upright and the helm stays light. Reef early: if you are wondering whether to reef, it is already time. Tie the reef points with a [[Knots for sailors#Reef knot|reef knot]].

## Slab reefing

Ease the main halyard, hook the reef cringle onto the boom, tension the halyard again, then haul the reefing line to pull the leech cringle down.

## When to reef

Most cruising boats take a first reef at about 15 knots of true wind and a second near 20. Heeling past 20 degrees and weather helm are the signs. Check [[Reading the wind]] for gusts on the water.
